versions.changelog:
Initial release of "决策复盘与反思助手":

- Provides structured frameworks for post-action reviews (AAR) and regular retrospectives.
- Supports analysis workflow from incident background to actionable improvements and decision principles.
- Includes guided prompts and quality checks to ensure concrete, verifiable outcomes.
- Offers scripts for both batch processing and interactive recording of retrospectives.
- Emphasizes privacy and does not transmit sensitive user data externally.
